New files to create: - web/src/auth/useTenantContext.ts — hook exposing tenantDisplayName, tenantSlug, isUnknown - web/src/auth/tokenUtils.ts (addition or new) — resolveTenantSlug(payload: JwtPayload): string | null - web/src/components/layout/TenantHeader.tsx — shows tenant name in nav; renders 'Unknown workspace' if null - web/src/pages/dashboard/TenantDashboardPage.tsx — landing page with

tenantDisplayName

and a welcome paragraph Files to modify: - web/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx — after login, call resolveTenantSlug and fetch GET /api/v1/tenants/{slug}; store tenant_slug and tenant_display_name in UserSession - web/src/router.tsx — index route renders TenantDashboardPage; add /dashboard alias - web/src/components/AppShell.tsx (or equivalent shell) — include TenantHeader Rules: - All API calls go through src/api/client.ts — no raw fetch in components (DIRECTIVE T-2) - No MSW, no HTTP mocking - Use GET /api/v1/tenants/{slug} to fetch display_name (or read from existing /api/v1/tenants endpoint) - If tenant_display_name cannot be resolved: show 'Unknown workspace', do not crash - No api_response verification in tests — screenshots only (follow DIRECTIVE T-3) Validation: python tools/lint_frontend_conventions.py web/src (exits 0, no BLOCKER/MAJOR) python tools/lint_test_isolation.py tests/integration (exits 0) cd web && npm run type-check (exits 0) cd web && npm run lint (exits 0) cd web && npm run build (exits 0) Commit: git add -A git commit -m 'feat(WF02): per-tenant dashboard and identity indicator (TD-UI-01, TD-UI-02, TD-UI-03)' git push origin feature/WF02-tenant-dashboard-20260616 Update handoff (COMPLETED, PASS/FAIL, completed_at real UTC) and registry.json.
